title: 1RB1LB_1LC0RD_0LE1LA_0RF1RA_1LE0LA_---0RB: one round trip is the cell automaton c'[p] = 1 xor c[p] xor c[p+3], in Lean
text: For every tape with no lone 1 before its first 00, Lean proves that a round trip rewrites the cells up to that point by c'[p] = 1 xor c[p] xor c[p+3] (three interleaved copies of rule 102), walls included, with the exact step count. A simulator built on it reaches 5.2·10<sup>13</sup> steps with no halt and no lone 1 after 8.5·10<sup>6</sup> steps, and a bulk 10 defect can only be born after a turn that ends a y-only segment behind a 111 wall: five such trips, all before 8.5·10<sup>6</sup> steps.
